name: Google Cloud
summary:
Google Cloud’s site is cloud.google.com. The cloud mark in the tab is separate from the Google Search “G”. Files were taken from this host and from icon URLs it declared.

Checked 12 November 2026 against cloud.google.com. HTML came from https://cloud.google.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/supercloud_favicon.ico; apple-touch-icon → https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/super_cloud_gradient.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/supercloud_favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 32038 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 64×64.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/super_cloud_gradient.png, measured at 192×192 png.

Brand colour #039be5 comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-192x192-01.png at 192×192 (png, 9447 bytes) from https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/super_cloud_gradient.png.
